⚙️ Process

From Nursery to Rooftop in Days

Our end-to-end process eliminates months of on-site growing. We grow it — you just roll it out.

1
🌱

Grow at Nursery

We pre-grow native Bangladeshi plant species on purpose-engineered growing mats at our Dhaka nursery for 8–12 weeks.

2
🎯

Quality Check & Roll

Each mat is inspected, tested for coverage and root density, then precision-rolled for transport without disturbing roots.

3
🚚

Deliver to Site

Rolled mats are delivered to your building in Dhaka within 48 hours. Our logistics covers all 64 districts across Bangladesh.

4
🏗️

Roll & Install

Our trained team rolls out the mat directly onto your prepared roof system. Fully established green roof — in one day.

📋

Ready to start your rooftop project?

Get a free site assessment within 72 hours. We evaluate your roof's structural capacity, drainage, and recommend the right system for your budget.

🌿 Our Story

Born from Dhaka's Urban Heat Crisis

Dhaka's rooftops bake at 55–60°C in April. Monsoon drains collapse every year. Green space keeps shrinking. The problem is real — and visible from every rooftop in the city.

GreenRoof BD was built on a simple premise: the roofs are already there. Let's put them to work. Drawing on published Dhaka-specific research showing green roofs reduce indoor temperatures by up to 4°C and cooling energy use by 31–35%, we're developing pre-grown rollable mats tailored for Bangladesh's monsoon climate.

We are not importing a European solution. This is built for Dhaka, by someone from Dhaka.

🌱

We Are Currently in Development

GreenRoof BD is an early-stage concept actively seeking seed funding, co-founders, and industry partnerships to move from concept to first prototype installation. If you are a developer, investor, NGO, or institution interested in green urban infrastructure — we want to hear from you.

→ Get in touch with us
👤 The Founder

The Person Behind GreenRoof BD

GreenRoof BD is currently a solo-founded venture. We're actively looking for co-founders, advisors, and team members who believe in greening Dhaka.

All Shahriya Islam Seaum

Founder & Owner — GreenRoof BD

Civil & Environmental Engineering · NSU Dhaka
"The city has the problem on every rooftop. I just want to give those rooftops a purpose."

Seaum is a final-year engineering student at North South University, Dhaka, and the sole founder of GreenRoof BD. He has spent years asking inconvenient questions about the city he grew up in — why it floods, why it keeps getting hotter, and why the solutions being adopted elsewhere haven't found their way here.

His work sits at the intersection of environmental engineering and entrepreneurship. He is equally at home reading published hydrology research and building the case for a business around it. He doesn't separate the two.

Outside of GreenRoof BD, Seaum runs Unfiltered — an independent editorial publication focused on analytical writing about Bangladeshi and global affairs. He has competed and placed in multiple student competitions centred on engineering and sustainability, including the Hult Prize. He manages paid media campaigns for US-based clients remotely.

He's not waiting to graduate to start building something that matters.

🌿 Green Infrastructure ✍️ Editorial / Writing 📡 Digital Marketing 🏆 Student Competition Winner

📅 Milestones

Our Journey So Far

An honest look at where we started and where we are now — a research-driven venture building toward its first real-world installation.

📚
2024–2025 Concept Born

Research, Concept & Feasibility

Seaum identified green roof mats as a viable, deployable solution for Dhaka's dual crisis of urban heat and monsoon flooding. Conducted an in-depth feasibility study using published Dhaka-specific research, BNBC structural load data, and local market analysis.

🏛️
Early 2026 🌟 Major Milestone

SAFECON 2026 — Poster Demonstration

"Green Roofs, Save Dhaka" was presented as a poster demonstration at SAFECON 2026 — one of Bangladesh's leading engineering and safety conferences. The stall attracted significant attention from industry professionals, sustainability experts, and academics.

The demonstration drew interest from engineers, sustainability practitioners, and academics across the industry. It opened genuine conversations about what a pre-grown rollable green roof system could mean for Bangladesh's built environment — and validated that the appetite for such a solution is very much real.

Presented with the support of North South University and the NSU Civil Engineering Club. Special thanks to Dr. Nur Mohammad Shuman and Dr. Asef M. Redwan for their mentorship throughout the process.

🌐
2026 Brand Launch

GreenRoof BD Brand & Web Presence Launched

Officially launched the GreenRoof BD brand, website, and concept to attract seed investors, co-founders, and construction firm partners. Began outreach to RAJUK and local developers for pilot site identification.

🚀
Next Step 🚀 Coming Next

Seed Funding, Co-Founders & First Pilot Install

Seeking seed capital, co-founders, and a willing building owner for our first monitored pilot installation. The goal: measure real temperature and runoff data from a Dhaka rooftop and publish findings to drive adoption.

🎯 Our Vision

Three Paths to A Greener Dhaka

GreenRoof BD is pursuing three distinct growth channels — each targeting a different segment of Dhaka's building stock. Together, they form a comprehensive strategy to mainstream green roofs in Bangladesh.

Channel 01 🏗️

B2B — Construction
Firm Partnerships

Embed GreenRoof BD mats into new developments from the architectural design stage. Developers benefit from a marketable sustainability credential; we gain repeatable volume contracts across multiple projects simultaneously.

✓Pre-specified in architectural drawings
✓Bulk supply agreements, predictable revenue
✓BNBC-compliant load analysis included
✓Co-branded green building marketing
→ Developers · Contractors · Architects
Channel 02 🏢

B2C — Direct Sales to
Building Owners

Retrofit existing rooftops for owners who want lower energy costs, better comfort, and a building that stands out. The rollable mat format makes this fast and practical — no months of on-site growing required.

✓Free structural site assessment
✓Transparent per-ft² pricing
✓Same-week installation
✓Annual maintenance available
→ Apartment Owners · Landlords · Institutions
Channel 03 📜

Policy — BNBC Green
Coverage Clause

Advocate for a mandatory 60% green roof coverage requirement within BNBC — mirroring policies already adopted in Singapore, Toronto, and Hamburg, where green roof mandates transformed entire urban building stocks and created thriving local industries.

→Evidence-backed proposals to RAJUK & Housing Ministry
→Partnerships with urban planning researchers & NGOs
→Pilot data as proof of concept for policy makers
→Become the easiest compliance path when mandates pass
→ Long-term play · Policy reform · Systemic impact
